column1: # Human authorizations to edit EXISTING test files (AGENTS.md › Test placement).
# One row per authorized file. Read from `pustman-v1/main` by:
#   - .claude/hooks/protect-steps-and-tests.sh: an `open` row lets a worker edit that file;
#   - scripts/promote-check.sh item 4: a modified test file passes only if it has a row.
# Only the driver adds rows, on pustman-v1/main, after the human authorizes in chat, quoting
# them. When the edit lands, flip the row to `used` and fill in the commit.
